subAccountUrl.title: Sub Account URL
subAccountUrl.description: Full URL of the GHL sub-account dashboard

leadName.title: Lead Name
leadName.description: Name of the lead to search for in global search

storageState.title: Storage State
storageState.description: Browser storageState JSON (cookies + localStorage). Export from loginMode run.

loginMode.title: Login Mode
loginMode.description: Set to true to open browser for manual login. Saves session for future runs.

screenshotOnly.title: Screenshot Only
screenshotOnly.description: When true, skips call recording search. Opens lead conversation and captures a screenshot only. Returns { screenshotUrl, format, sizeBytes }.

alwaysScreenshot.title: Always screenshot the call
alwaysScreenshot.description: Full mode only. When true, the call screenshot is taken even if the call is under the 5:00 threshold. Duration and meetsThreshold are still reported as normal.
